description: Anticipation over the three Rust RL interventions actually trained in this phase: GRPO, DPO and PPO on the executable-verified Rust cohort. The arms are deliberately not matched to one another -- each runs at the operating point where that algorithm actually learns -- so the anchor descriptions state each arm's own cohort size and number of passes. Targets, tiers and label rotation are copied from coding_drift_anticipation_v2 unchanged so RL and SFT forecasts land on the same instrument and the same cells. The full concreteness ladder is asked of the four write-language targets v2 also asks it of: Rust is the trained one, and C#/Go/PHP are untrained by RL while being exactly the cells the SFT battery forecasts, which makes the two batteries directly comparable rather than merely similar.

target_groups.label: Writing, all nine languages (4 trained + 5 untrained probes)
target_groups.question: Does training on a task make the model want that task more or less, and how far does the shift reach along the language-similarity gradient?

target_groups.label: The other eight coding tasks (debug / explain, trained languages)
target_groups.question: Does the shift transfer across tasks and languages within coding?

target_groups.label: Non-coding activities (activity level)
target_groups.question: Does coding training spill over onto non-coding preferences?

anchor_groups.label: Training-method axis with language fixed at Rust

analysis_tiers.primary: The four write-language targets, crossed with each RL anchor, at all three levels.
analysis_tiers.secondary: The five untrained write-language targets, the cross-task coding targets, and the nine non-coding activities, at primary_level.

level_availability_note: example_datapoints is available for coding.grpo.rust and coding.dpo.rust now; coding.ppo.rust is blocked until its training run produces real rollouts.
preregistration_note: This is the pre-registered three-anchor battery. It does not validate while coding.ppo.rust carries example_datapoints_source=blocked_pending_training_run: the experiment-spec guard requires every anchor to be able to show real training examples, and that guard is doing its job. Run coding_drift_anticipation_v3_rust_rl_grpo_dpo.json in the meantime; this spec becomes runnable unchanged once the PPO rollouts land and build_rust_rl_stimuli.py fills the field. M0 weights are fixed, so collecting the PPO forecast later is still a prospective M0 forecast, not a backfill -- provided no RL arm's drift has been inspected first.
